replay.categories: Only the unit metadata-collision row supplies structured metadata in this selection. Its want and all metric oracles are flat labels; no categorized expected labels are invented. Engine loads retain separate labels and metadata owners (both selected metadata maps are empty). The complete selected explicit-path engine block contains no select evaluations or categorized entry expectations; expected_entries stays empty and no parse-all/ownership cases from the preceding block are imported.
replay.constructors: All five constructor_failure_cases preserve the exact ordered expression, original error suffix and full expected error. The full error is assembled only with the original fmt.Sprintf template from the upstream assertion at 812, not generated by a parser or inferred from Pulse. These are parser-construction oracles, not complete HTTP admission-error envelopes.
replay.engine: Times, steps and repeat intervals are integer seconds relative to 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. Replay may shift the entire fixture to a deterministic retained epoch, preserving every relative timestamp. Repeat count includes the first entry: start+i*every for i=0..count-1. Keep both app=a and app=noise loads, their order and all eight entries; reset only on clear. Engine log strings preserve content between delimiters without unescaping, unlike Go AST string literals. Query text excludes only quote-aware trailing source comments; raw preserves them.
replay.grammar: want preserves typed path components: strings stay strings and integer array indexes stay integers. All rows assert path equality, including want=null for the empty expression. The harness returns without checking err whenever its table error is nil, including empty and all 11 nonempty-path rows. Consequently error=null with error_assertion=not_asserted is provenance, NOT an assertion that parsing succeeds. Empty is outcome=nil_path, never invented accept/reject. Only the six nonnil-error rows assert an exact error string. Grammar rows have no invented destination, line or HTTP query.
replay.hints: hint_expression is inert original Go source. Only invalid JSON line with hints (669-681) uses NewParserHint([]string{"__error__"}, nil, false, true, ""); the other 28 use NoParserHints(). Public ordinary-stage replay can compare the frozen flat error oracle but cannot claim to exercise the hinted builder, extraction selection or short-circuit behavior. Do not drop the row or alter its expected labels.
replay.metrics: Instant cases have equal start/end and step=0; range cases have explicit steps. Expected series contain exact combined labels and original numeric-string slots at start+i*step. An underscore is a missing point, never zero. outcome=reject keeps the exact upstream expected message substring in reject, not a full HTTP error body. No case expects empty output. expected_entries=[] is a mode placeholder, not an expect-empty assertion.
replay.requirements: Normal replay reads committed JSON using Elixir/Rust JSON only, without Go, network or expectation generation. The producer is optional provenance tooling, not a build/test dependency.
replay.table: Each expression_cases row is one original flat LabelsResult().Labels() oracle. fields is an ordered array of [destination, path_expression] pairs, not a map; expressions_expression preserves the original Go declaration. Resolve testLine from its exact source literal at 404, without JSON reserialization. Preserve every malformed/empty/escaped/duplicate-key line exactly. base_labels is the stream owner; structured_metadata attaches after reset and before parsing; initial_parsed_labels={} records no previous parsed state. want is combined, NOT a categorized oracle. Metadata nil becomes {} for replay; metadata_expression retains nil versus a literal map. The harness ignores Process return values and does not assert a rewritten line or keep flag; do not invent those expectations.
